title: phrygilanthus acutifolius
intro: Phrygilanthus acutifolius, commonly known as the 'Pali-Tuss' or 'Pali-Rasa', is a plant species that belongs to the family Apocynaceae. It is native to tropical forests of the Western Ghats in India, where it has been used in traditional Ayurvedic medicine for its medicinal properties. The health benefits of Phrygilanthus acutifolius include its antispasmodic, anti-inflammatory, and expectorant properties, which help to alleviate respiratory issues such as bronchitis and asthma. The bioactive constituents of this plant include alkaloids, flavonoids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its therapeutic actions, including bronchodilation and cough suppression.
